name: Text-to-Transfer Function
aliases: T2TF Transfer Function Parameterization and Optimization
definition: A method for designing transfer functions (TF) for volume rendering using text prompts via a contrastive loss function, optimizing TF parameters (control point locations, density, and color) to match user-provided semantic descriptions while discouraging negative prompts.
summary: Text-to-Transfer Function optimizes transfer function parameters for a fixed scalar field using text prompts, contrasting with methods that optimize fixed 3D fields.
